description: RCQ-Map labels a real clinical query, the request a clinician sends to an AI assistant, with the task it asks for, the intent behind it, whether it contains the information a safe answer needs, the potential harm of an incorrect answer and the safest response. This archive holds the annotation guidelines, the output schema, the rcqmap annotator (annotate, derive, compare, bundle, verify), a clinician validation kit and the blinded clinician annotation platform. Version 1.0.0 accompanies the preprint: Vishwanath et al., Clinician use of language models diverges from how the models are evaluated, arXiv:2610.11069 (2026), https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2610.11069.
access_conditions: Files will be opened when the accompanying manuscript is posted as a preprint. Editors and reviewers may request access.
